findings.fact: The historical Vitest environment was jsdom.
The historical test setup did not install a Worker implementation.
findings.evidence: c5a33af:src/test/setup.ts only imports jest-dom, cleanup, and afterEach.

findings.fact: Stockfish could not initialize without Worker and analysis then used the fallback engine.
findings.evidence: c5a33af:src/services/stockfishService.ts returns false when Worker is undefined; analyzeFen then calls fallbackAnalysis, whose source is fallback.

findings.fact: The historical latency test had no Worker mock and did not observe real worker commands.
findings.evidence: c5a33af:src/test/gameLatency.test.ts directly calls analyzeGame in jsdom and contains no Worker replacement or worker telemetry.

findings.fact: The historical analyzer hardcoded stockfish_wasm into output facts and the top-level result even when engine calls fell back.
findings.evidence: c5a33af:src/services/analysis/gameAnalyzer.ts writes source: 'stockfish_wasm' into placeholder facts, analyzed facts, and the returned engine object.

findings.fact: The historical test asserted the hardcoded top-level source and printed a literal source string.
findings.evidence: c5a33af:src/test/gameLatency.test.ts prints 'Engine source: stockfish_wasm' and only asserts result.engine.source.

findings.fact: The requested movetimeMs 500 was not forwarded in the historical first-pass analyzeFen calls.
findings.evidence: c5a33af:src/services/analysis/gameAnalyzer.ts first-pass analyzeFen calls provide fen/depth/elo, not movetimeMs.

findings.fact: The historical report itself recorded zero second-pass positions.
findings.evidence: c5a33af:docs/PHASE_1_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md records 80 first-pass positions, zero second-pass positions, and a 5772 ms median.

The requested comparison is 5365 ms; c5a33af:docs/FINAL_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md calls 5365-5377 ms 'previously reported', while the implementation report records a fresh-looking 5772 ms median. Neither proves real Worker execution.

explanation: The fresh browser benchmark performs 83 completed real Stockfish searches per run. At movetime 500 ms, those commands alone imply a 41,500 ms nominal search-time floor. The observed 42,764 ms median is about 1,264 ms above that floor and remains below the historical 60-second gate. The 697.1% increase over 5,365 ms is therefore a workload/provenance correction, not evidence of a like-for-like regression.
